latency_requirements: first-token <1.5s (SLO). 90th perc token start <2.5s for typical 256-512 token convo. streaming required for progressive UX.

notes: Shorthand notes from calls: 'need streaming + toolcall; agent must see suggested action within 1.5s or UX falls apart'
Customer stack: React front-end, Node backend, internal ticketing API (REST), Postgres KB + vector DB (Milvus).
POC goals: validate first-token latency, end-to-end tool calling (search KB -> call ticket API -> return summary), correctness/regression monitoring.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget. Will evaluate hosted pricing first; if token costs > projected threshold, move to Dedicated reserved capacity.
Security: must pass SAML SSO + audit log ingestion to their SIEM. Also want optional key wrapping with their KMS for Dedicated.
SE notes: want sample trace capture (token-level timing) and per-route cost breakdown during POC.
Quote from Dir. Product: 'If streaming first-token is slow we lose conversion — we need <1.5s to match current chat experience.'

POC acceptance criteria: 1) first-token median <0.8s, 95th <1.5s for 256 token context; 2) tool call latency end-to-end <300ms additional; 3) no PII leakage in logs; 4) cost <= $X per convo (TBD in pricing call).
next_step: Schedule hosted POC kickoff (4-week). SE to push POC runbook + test vector list. AE to send POC contract addendum and pricing scenarios for Dedicated.
blockers: InfoSec wants formal audit log retention options + SLA language for retention
